decisions.reason: Because this resin injection unit had a dedicated page for two years and fits the firm's customized fluid-handling offer, management is likely to justify continued support and treat any weakness as temporary.
This product shows the same visible launch commitment and strategic fit as A, so sunk development effort and public positioning make withdrawal relatively unlikely.
An automatic airless spray gun is central to the firm's core application-technology business, so prior investment and public commitment favor keeping it on the market.
A manual airless spray gun is also close to the established product base and installed customer needs, which encourages persistence rather than exit.
As a multi-model product line in a core spray-gun category, it reflects the strongest resource commitment and strategic importance, making a drop decision least likely.
The data logger had weaker visible follow-through after launch and is less central than the firm's main mechanical equipment lines, so management is more willing to discontinue it.
